start.headline: Most families need more than one email before they visit.
start.body: Here's how Banner Connect keeps the conversation going for ten days, so your staff doesn't have to remember to.

steps.alt: The nurture workflow with three emails separated by 3-day and 7-day waits
steps.title: Three emails, spaced out on purpose
steps.body: Day 1 sends the info packet. Day 3 explains what makes your school different. Day 10 invites the family to take the next step.

steps.alt: Nurture email #2 explaining holistic learning, character development and faith-integrated curriculum
steps.title: Day 3: why your school
steps.body: This one speaks to what parents are really asking: will my child be ready for life, not just tests? It covers faith-integrated learning, character and academics.

steps.alt: Nurture email #3 with links to schedule a visit, learn about financial aid and apply
steps.title: Day 10: an easy next step
steps.body: The last email offers three clear paths: schedule a visit, explore financial aid, or start an application. Each one is a single click.

steps.alt: The email template library in grid view
steps.title: Every email is a template you can edit
steps.body: Change the wording once and every family gets the new version. Your school's name, address and phone fill in automatically.

steps.alt: The Prebuilt Workflows folder listing seven admissions automations
steps.title: A sequence for every kind of inquiry
steps.body: Tuition questions, financial aid, visits, events and families who went quiet each get their own follow-up, already built and ready to turn on.

finish.headline: Ten days of thoughtful follow-up, and nobody had to hit send.
finish.body: Your team steps in when a family is ready to talk. The emails handle the rest.
